key_idea: A station is suitable iff it is reachable from both starts in the directed graph, so run two BFS and intersect.
sketch: Build the directed adjacency list, BFS from a and from b, and print any vertex visited by both, else 'no'. O(n+m). Edges are one-way, so do not treat the graph as undirected; the start stations themselves count as reachable. Any common vertex is accepted; samples pass and a random comparison against a brute-force reachability closure agreed on 500 small graphs.
